highlights: Native local Freerouting: revision-bound DSN export, Freerouting MCP routing, dry-run SES validation, and atomic KiCad apply.
Claude Desktop now receives the full 221-tool catalogue at initialization.
Windows kicad-cli installation discovery enables ERC, DRC, and exports without a hand-entered executable path.
Lost live KiCad connections no longer silently fall back to stale files.
Stronger skills, agents, hooks, pin-map checks, manufacturing evidence, footprint refresh, ownership, and hierarchy handling.

compatibility.testedPlatforms: KiCad 10; release packages for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
compatibility.guidanceStatus: Claude receives the bundled guidance; Codex users should pair this release with konnect-codex v0.11.1.
compatibility.mcpClientStatus: Claude Desktop gets eager tools. Dynamic MCP clients keep the smaller starter catalogue and can load toolsets on demand.
compatibility.workflowStatus: Tools connect and the native routing pipeline is implemented; the initial SES importer supports straight tracks and through vias while preserving locked straight routing.
compatibility.restartSteps: Restart the MCP client after upgrading so it discovers the new server and tool catalogue.
compatibility.knownLimitations: The initial native Freerouting import profile does not yet cover every Specctra geometry form.

highlights: Removed the duplicate Python/JAR router; Codex now drives Konnect's native check, DSN export, Freerouting MCP route, SES plan, and SES apply pipeline.
Added a discoverable kicad-workflows router for intake, libraries, schematics, PCB work, recovery, review, manufacturing, and bring-up.
Added task-owned process cleanup without broad KiCad, Java, or helper-process termination.
Added PCB-layout physics acceptance for return planes, critical loops, power and thermal paths, RF, edge clearance, via process, and production test access.
Added the v0.11.1 unsafe-file-fallback recovery boundary and stronger revision, inventory, DRC, and evidence gates.

compatibility.testedPlatforms: CI passed on Windows, Linux, and macOS; exact-version matched to Konnect v0.11.1.
compatibility.guidanceStatus: 9 reviewed Codex skills, 5 specialist agents, structured hooks, and 26 active enhancements.
compatibility.mcpClientStatus: Codex companion for Konnect v0.11.1; the native Konnect MCP catalogue remains the tool source.
compatibility.workflowStatus: Tools connect; local sync and doctor passed all 45 managed files. Full guided PCB success still depends on project-specific ERC, DRC, routing, and manufacturing evidence.
compatibility.restartSteps: Run konnect-codex sync and konnect-codex doctor, then start a new Codex task.
compatibility.knownLimitations: Use the companion release that exactly matches the installed Konnect release.
